methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: Community-driven AI evaluation initiative in Roanoke Valley signals peer-learning infrastructure forming outside metro hubs, testing whether deep capability can emerge through collaborative discovery rather than platform dependence or venture capital.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Local backlash forcing Amazon to scrap four data centers reveals that infrastructure concentration doesn't automatically translate to distributed AI capability—community resistance may prevent even shallow adoption from spreading beyond server farms.

signals.title: Norfolk, Newport News police launch AI tool for non-emergency calls - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk and Newport News deploying turnkey AI tools for non-emergency calls demonstrates platform-delivered adoption reaching mid-tier cities, but implementation in narrow municipal use cases suggests shallow integration rather than workforce capability building.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Governor's statewide AI cybersecurity mandate could either distribute defensive capabilities across regions or concentrate expertise in Richmond and NoVA depending on whether implementation empowers local IT teams or routes through centralized contractors.

signals.title: Military spouse uses AI to help veterans navigate VA benefits - DC Military
signals.signal_reading: Military spouse creating AI navigation tools for VA benefits exemplifies grassroots capability development outside traditional tech centers, suggesting deep skills can emerge from mission-driven individuals rather than institutional programs—true distributed innovation.
